name: teamwork-skill
description: AI-native collaboration skills for direct work, discussion, deep research, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and persistent goals in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Focused collaboration methods that keep clear work direct.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork keeps clear Codex work native and adds focused methods only when discussion, full Deep Research, unknown-cause debugging, executable planning, independent review, project setup, global refresh, exact-root document migration, or persistent convergence needs them. Explorer remains an internal local-evidence role, Reviewer covers plan review, and Writer maintains six typed project documents without exposing storage mechanics. Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to refresh Teamwork and migrate this exact project's documents to the current format.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to explore this decision with me and recommend a direction.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this external question across primary sources.
